description: VC-BLD-08: asymmetric legs 1 (top face) x 2 (side face), circular section (elliptic quarter), on the top edge of a 20x10x5 block
formula: V = abc - L (1 - pi/4) d1 d2 = 1000 - 20 (1 - pi/4) 2; centroid from the spandrel (the region of the d1 x d2 rectangle outside the quarter circle, centroid 0.22338 d from the corner): it tells which face carries the first leg
